tests.title: Operator relay resolution precedence is flag, env, then system discovery
tests.description: Exercises relay precedence and deduplication for the CLI operator path.
preconditions: CLI operator globals are reset between runs.
steps: Resolve relays with flag input.
Resolve relays with env input.
Resolve relays from system info fallback.
tests.expected_result: Relay resolution follows precedence and dedupes duplicate URLs.
data_requirements: Stable relay URL strings for flag/env/system cases.
determinism_notes: Pure CLI resolution logic; no live relay required.

tests.title: Raw-target mode requires explicit fallback and skips signer-first publish when approved
steps: Invoke adoption scan with raw-target and no fallback.
Repeat with explicit fallback enabled.
tests.expected_result: No-fallback mode errors immediately; fallback mode uses only the compatibility path.

tests.title: Operator client subscribes before publish and resolves only correlated replies
tests.description: Confirms subscribe-before-publish and correlation rules for signer-first replies.
steps: Execute a runtime action through the operator client.
Inject invalid, duplicate, and correlated replies.
tests.expected_result: Subscription occurs before publish and only the correlated reply resolves the request.
data_requirements: Stable request/reply private keys and request ids.
determinism_notes: Reply events are injected directly without timers or live relays.

tests.title: Signer-first adoption targets reject docker_host before publish and publish endpoint-ref-only requests
tests.description: Covers client-side docker_host validation, endpoint-ref-only published request content, and reactor-visible normalized target tagging for signer-first adoption scan/import.
preconditions: Operator client is initialized with fake transport.
steps: Attempt scan with docker_host target.
Execute valid scan/import and inspect published content.
tests.expected_result: docker_host validation fails pre-publish; valid requests include endpoint refs and omit docker_host.
data_requirements: Stable target names, endpoint refs, and selection values.

tests.title: Unauthorized adoption request produces failed terminal result without service dispatch
tests.description: Verifies reactor-side scoped authorization for signer-first adoption requests.
preconditions: Reactor is configured with adoption allowlist excluding requester pubkey.
steps: Deliver an unauthorized scan request.
Inspect service invocation and result event.
tests.expected_result: No adoption service call occurs and a failed result is published with unauthorized metadata.
determinism_notes: All control-plane events are handled in-process.

tests.title: Signer-first adoption scan result stays sanitized
tests.description: Checks redaction behavior and docker_host omission in signer-first scan results.
preconditions: Stub adoption service returns preview with safe and redacted metadata.
steps: Execute a signer-first scan request.
Decode the published result payload.
tests.expected_result: Safe values remain, redacted key names remain, secret values and docker_host are absent.
fixtures: stub adoption service with mixed metadata
data_requirements: Stable preview fixture with safe env/labels and redacted keys.

tests.title: Adoption import partial-failure status is preserved for mixed outcomes
tests.description: Verifies partial-failure result tagging for mixed import outcomes in the signer-first import path.
steps: Execute signer-first import with mixed result statuses via reactor test.
Decode the terminal result payload and inspect the terminal status tag.
tests.expected_result: Mixed results publish `partial_failure` and preserve per-container status/error data.
data_requirements: Stable import result set with one success and one failure.
determinism_notes: Validation and result tagging are deterministic.

tests.title: Direct-runtime requests enforce action validation and scoped authorization
tests.description: Exercises invalid artifact usage and unauthorized runtime action behavior.
preconditions: Reactor is configured with direct-runtime scope or fallback allowlist under test.
steps: Submit stop with artifact_id.
Submit restart from unauthorized requester.
Submit valid deploy/restart/stop actions.
tests.expected_result: Invalid shapes and unauthorized requests fail before runtime execution; valid actions execute.
data_requirements: Stable UUID strings for service, environment, and artifact.

tests.title: Successful direct-runtime actions emit signed processing status and runtime result DTOs
tests.description: Verifies signed status/result emission and DTO decoding for a successful runtime action.
preconditions: Stub runtime lifecycle service returns a runtime observation.
steps: Execute successful signer-first deploy, restart, and stop requests.
Inspect the published status and result events and decode each result payload.
tests.expected_result: For deploy, restart, and stop, exactly one processing status precedes one success result, both are signed, and each result payload decodes into `RuntimeActionResponse`.
determinism_notes: Event signing and DTO shaping are exercised locally.

tests.title: Explicit HTTP fallback is limited to pre-acceptance failures
tests.description: Confirms pre-acceptance failures originate from the operator client and that CLI fallback depends on `ControlPlaneRequestError.RequestAccepted`.
preconditions: CLI operator globals are reset and fallback is enabled.
steps: Trigger a pre-acceptance operator-client error.
Trigger a post-acceptance terminal signer-first error.
tests.expected_result: Fallback runs only for the pre-acceptance case.

tests.title: CLI progress output is stderr-only in table mode
tests.description: Confirms operator status callbacks do not pollute structured stdout output.
steps: Emit status callback in JSON mode.
Emit status callback in table mode.
tests.expected_result: JSON mode emits nothing; table mode writes progress lines to stderr.

implementation_notes: The slice is verified primarily through deterministic Go tests across reactor, API handler, operator client, and CLI packages.
HTTP compatibility behavior is covered only to the extent needed to prove the signer-first fallback boundary.
Release approval now requires a stored local Docker+relay rehearsal artifact in addition to the deterministic tests tracked here.
